{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling the thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion
print("Revenue converted successfully.")

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age values (age == -1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of customers who converted and have valid age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers who converted (excluding age = -1): {mean_age_converted}")"}
